原始无损录音经音量调整并转成 MP3。每个文件保留完整读音和原语速。
「石」采用同音字「十」的单字录音，两者在这里都读 shí。
Each complete FLAC recording was level-adjusted and encoded as MP3 at its
original speed. 石 uses the isolated syllable shí recorded for 十. The MP3
metadata includes the original FLAC filename.
